key_findings: **WPF-style 2-tier delegate inheritance structurally confirmed.** Derived ctors (KeyEventHandler<LuaDebugLog>::ctor at FUN_0059A3F0 + RoutedEventHandler<LuaDebugSelect>::ctor at FUN_0068E300 + SelectionChangedEventHandler<LuaDebugSelect>::ctor at FUN_0068E3E0) all follow the classic MSVC derived-ctor pattern: call parent ctor (which sets base vftable + captures target/method/extra fields), then overwrite vftable with derived. All 3 derived ctors are 105B bodies, all 3 generic-EventHandler bases are 109B - identical size confirms identical code generation pattern across the 3 owner classes / 3 event types.

**EventHandler<LuaDebugSelect,RoutedEventArgs> is EMBEDDED INLINE in LuaDebugSelect at offset +0x34.** Per FUN_0068DD50 LuaDebugSelect::dtor: restores LuaDebugSelect::vftable to *this and *(this+2) (primary + MI secondary), destroys an owned heap object at this[+0x32] via virtual slot 0 call, then writes EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>::vftable to this[+0x34] (restoring the inline sub-object's vftable on the way down). This is NOT the standard WPF heap-delegate model - the owner class includes the delegate as a direct member field. May be an optimization for delegates that are bound 1:1 with the owner's lifetime. Whether the SelectionChanged delegate is also inline (at a different offset) is not yet confirmed but seems likely.

**Standard MSVC delegate capture-layout** confirmed at this[+0x20]/[+0x28]/[+0x2C] (param_1[8]/[10]/[11] in Ghidra's int-indexed notation). 3 captured fields: target object pointer, member function pointer, and a third 'extra' arg (possibly the secondary base class adjustment for MI cases, or the bound argument for 1-arg delegates). All 3 EventHandler<T,EventArgs> base ctors set these same fields; the derived delegates (KeyEventHandler / RoutedEventHandler / SelectionChangedEventHandler) inherit them without adding new fields - they only override the vftable for type discrimination.

**Single binder per owner class pattern.** FUN_00599CB0 is the sole caller of KeyEventHandler<LuaDebugLog>::ctor. FUN_0068DDF0 is the sole caller of BOTH RoutedEventHandler<LuaDebugSelect>::ctor AND SelectionChangedEventHandler<LuaDebugSelect>::ctor (so it constructs both delegates needed by LuaDebugSelect). Suggests a centralized 'register all my event handlers' method per owner class - possibly invoked from the owner's ctor or in a deferred-init pass.
